cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(WindowsLoaderSelection NONE)
include("${SELECTION_MODULE}")
set(WIN32 "${CASE_WINDOWS}")
set(MSVC "${CASE_MSVC}")
add_library(core STATIC EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/empty.cpp")
set_target_properties(core PROPERTIES LINKER_LANGUAGE CXX)
configure_windows_loader(core "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/WindowsMpvLoader.cpp")
get_target_property(sources core INTERFACE_SOURCES)
get_target_property(links core INTERFACE_LINK_LIBRARIES)
get_target_property(options core INTERFACE_LINK_OPTIONS)
if(CASE_WINDOWS AND CASE_MSVC)
  if(NOT sources STREQUAL "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/WindowsMpvLoader.cpp" OR
     NOT links STREQUAL "delayimp.lib" OR NOT options STREQUAL "/DELAYLOAD:libmpv-2.dll")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Windows loader selection is incomplete")
  endif()
elseif(sources OR links OR options)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Windows loader dependencies selected on unsupported platform")
endif()
